# E0344: a constant in a lens is not an instance of its target field

A constant written in a lens is an instance of the target field it fills. Here
a string is written where the target declares an int; CUE's account of the
conflict is in the detail.

## Example

`ship/history/0.0.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	a: string
}
```

`ship/history/1.0.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	a: string
	b: int
}

ForwardLens: {
	v0_0: _
	v1_0: {
		b: "one"
	}
}
```

`ship/tip.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	a: string
	b: int
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0344]: "one" is not an instance of 1.0's b
 --> ship/history/1.0.thema:9:6
  |
3 |     b: int
  |        --- here
...
9 |         b: "one"
  |            ^^^^^
  |            ----- also here
  |
  = detail: schema.b: conflicting values int and "one" (mismatched types int and string)
```
